leads.Personalized Subject Line: An idea for the quiet calendar (and Careless Whispers)
leads.Personalized Email Body:
Hi Oquirrh,

My name is Roland Jacobs; I work as a designer and book services specialist, helping authors present, publish, and promote their work.

I came across the quiet calendar and Careless Whispers while researching your work. I was particularly interested in the day-by-day structure of the quiet calendar, and in the way the collection keeps count of grief.

They made me think a TikTok Shop video series could be a good fit for bringing the books to more readers who would enjoy them. Short poetry excerpts suit social video; a simple shop-linked video series could put the quiet calendar in front of poetry readers.

If it's useful, I could prepare a complimentary concept sample to show the idea more concretely.

Would that be of interest?

Best regards,
Roland Jacobs
